name: Chinwe Phommachanh
role: Building superintendent, Lockhaven South residential stack
location: Lockhaven South, Stack Eleven — he lives in the sub-basement maintenance unit, near Milwaukee and North Ave
description:
Chinwe Phommachanh is enormous — six-foot-four with the kind of bulk that comes from two decades of hauling pipes and climbing maintenance shafts, not from any gym program. His skin is deep brown with a reddish undertone, and his face carries a network of small scars from a gas line incident in his thirties that he never had properly treated. He keeps his head shaved and his beard trimmed with almost military precision, the one vanity he allows himself. His eyes are a startling pale grey-green, a recessive gift from his Finnish grandmother that people find unsettling until they realize how rarely he blinks in a crisis.

Stack Eleven houses 340 units of mixed Tier 1-2 residents and Chinwe Phommachanh runs it with the quiet authority of someone who has fixed every pipe, knows every squeaky panel, and has personally carried two elderly tenants out during a partial floor collapse three years ago. He is not beloved in the way that warm people are beloved — he's respected in the way that a load-bearing wall is respected. He has no patience for bureaucracy and extraordinary patience for people. He maintains a small shrine to the E.L.F. he calls Boiler-Father in the sub-basement furnace room, and believes deeply that the building's mechanical systems have a will of their own that rewards or punishes based on how people treat them.

core_fears: the building failing because Palladian won't fund repairs and people getting hurt
being responsible for something he couldn't prevent
core_desires: for the stack to outlast the corporation that owns it
to be left alone to do his job without interference
coping_mechanisms: displacement — fixing the building instead of himself
blind_spots: cannot recognize loneliness in himself, only in others
believes competence and care are the same thing
psychology.secret: He has been quietly siphoning power from Palladian's maintenance budget allocation — not for himself, but to fund heating repairs in the lowest floors that corporate refused to approve. He keeps meticulous records of every diverted quanta in a paper ledger, as if documentation makes it less theft. If Palladian audits, he'll lose everything.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Terse, technical when discussing the building, surprisingly poetic when discussing people — different registers, both sincere
speech_patterns.cadence: Slow delivery, long pauses, never raises his voice
example_lines: 'She's been making that noise for two weeks. That means she's asking, not demanding. Come back in a week and she'll be demanding.'
'I don't care why it happened. I care that it doesn't happen again in my building.'

story_hooks: Palladian sends an auditor to Stack Eleven and Brecht needs someone he trusts — which is almost no one — to help him make the books look right before they arrive
Something is living in the sub-basement below the furnace room, below where even Brecht's maintenance maps go, and Boiler-Father has stopped answering his prayers
narrative_function: Building-level authority figure, potential quest giver when something goes wrong in the stack, information source on tenant activity and building infrastructure, moral anchor in a community under stress.
augmentations: Subdermal pressure sensors in both hands (allows him to detect gas leaks and pipe stress by touch — installed after the gas line incident). Spinal brace, partially biointegrated, from the same incident.
daily_life: Begins rounds at 0500, checks boiler, water recyclers, and elevator hydraulics before most residents wake. Takes complaints at his door from 0800 to 0900 only, no exceptions. Eats lunch alone in the furnace room with Boiler-Father.
affiliation: Independent contractor to Palladian Property Holdings (his actual employer, whom he resents)

decision_rules: the building's residents come before the building's owners
if he can fix it himself, he does — he only asks for help when someone could get hurt
escalation_ladder: putting his body between the problem and the residents

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Assesses quietly before speaking, leads with practical help rather than words
interpersonal_modes.friends: Expresses care entirely through action — fixing things, showing up, remembering details

stress_responses.medium: Works through the night, stops eating
stress_responses.high: Goes completely silent and handles everything himself, refuses all help

contradictions: believes in rules but breaks them constantly for the right reasons
intensely private but knows the intimate details of 340 households
habits: checking boiler pressure three times even when it's fine
always carrying a ration bar he never eats
talking quietly to building systems when he thinks no one can hear
breaking_points: a child getting hurt in the building due to neglect he couldn't prevent
Palladian threatening to evict long-term residents for profit

physical_description.heritage: Southeast Asian-dominant genetic heritage (46.1%) interwoven with significant Sub-Saharan African (20.4%), South Asian (15.4%), East Asian (11.2%), and Eastern European (6.9%) ancestry. This rare Diaspora combination manifests as a striking phenotypic blend: deep warm brown skin with subtle olive undertones from the Southeast and South Asian genetic contributions, angular facial structure reflecting East and South Asian bone architecture, and pale grey-green eyes—a recessive Eastern European trait emerging through the genetic mosaic. The overall effect is distinctly non-monolithic, a living example of 22nd-century ancestry complexity where heritage flows visibly through multiple continental lineages simultaneously.
physical_description.build: Massive and solid without excess fat — the build of someone who has spent two decades moving through tight spaces and hauling load. Broad shoulders, thick forearms, hands scarred and calloused from decades of manual work. Carries himself with the economy of movement of someone who knows the weight and space of their own body.
physical_description.hair_color: Black with silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Shaved skull, maintained with military precision every third day
physical_description.eye_color: Pale grey-green — striking and unusual against his deep brown skin, rarely blinking
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with subtle olive undertones, the complexion of someone who works in heat and humidity. Rich melanin density reflecting Southeast and Sub-Saharan ancestry, with underlying warmth from South Asian genetics.
physical_description.complexion: Face mapped with a fine network of thin white scars radiating across left cheek and jawline from old thermal burn damage — never fully healed cosmetically, only functionally. The scars form an almost accidental pattern, like frost on glass. Strong angular jawline and high cheekbones reflecting Southeast and East Asian bone structure combined with subtle width through the lower face from African and South Asian heritage. Trimmed beard kept short, dark with silver. Deep-set eyes that seem to assess constantly. Lines around the eyes and mouth from forty-four years of serious expression.
distinguishing_marks: Network of fine white scars across left cheek and jawline in organic branching pattern, result of thermal gas line incident approximately fifteen years prior
Calloused ridge scarring across both palms and inner fingers from decades of pipe handling and wrench work
Faint discoloration along spine (lower thoracic region) where biointegrated spinal brace interface sits — slightly raised, almost imperceptible unless skin is in direct light
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Minimal. The spinal brace is mostly invisible beneath clothing, though a trained observer might notice the slight rigidity in his movements and the geometric bulge visible along his back if he wears fitted shirts. The subdermal pressure sensors in his hands are completely internal — only visible as faint geometric scarring on the heel of each palm where insertion occurred.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with deliberate efficiency — no wasted motion. Stands with shoulders slightly forward from decades of working in confined spaces. Walks with a subtle favoring of hip flexors due to spinal brace. Rarely gestures while speaking. Hands at rest are often slightly curved, as if holding something. In crisis, becomes perfectly still and methodical.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 working class, practical and worn. Grey and navy synthetic maintenance coveralls with Palladian Property Holdings patch (which he wears with visible resentment). Under them, plain cotton t-shirts, usually grey or black. Thick-soled work boots, always clean but heavily scuffed. A single piece of jewelry: a worn brass ring on his left middle finger, no inscription visible. In off-hours, he wears the same coveralls or black cargo pants and faded sweaters. No decoration, no chrome, no fashion. Everything chosen for durability and function.
